lines.text: Workers made specially woven garments, and for the ephod they hammered gold thin and cut threads from it.
They engraved the onyx stones with the names of Israel's sons and fastened them on the ephod's shoulder pieces.
The breastpiece held four rows of gemstones, and each of the twelve stones was engraved with a tribe's name.
They made the robe entirely of scarlet cloth and put gold bells between the pomegranates on its hem.
They engraved HOLY TO THE LORD on the gold plate and fastened it with a blue cord to the sash.
